decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): Find why cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py reds and fix it so that the proof reseals green. Keys: red:cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py::test_fixme_refuses_exit_while_an_entry_is_unanswered, red:cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py::test_fixme_admits_exit_once_every_entry_is_answered, red:cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py::test_fixme. Root cause (one, shared by 62a8ecb673a7, 02f0e9eee497, d2a76ee449ba): patch-in-the-asker. The proof repoints ticket_file._TICKETS in its own process, but since 0c2c3f53c2be the gates' judges (crossing_named_ticket, crossing_fixme) run in a launched CodeMother, so the patch never reaches them and the fixture ticket reads as not cast. Fix: the fixture also opens inspect_wire.launch(ticket_store=<the same dir>) for its block (3e08102ef35a's named store); the in-process patch stays for emit's own in-process reads.
